title: CSV ledger writing its header exactly once across appends
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the exists/size check as a race if two processes append simultaneously. The stated contract covers sequential appends and reopening — header exactly once in those cases, decided by missing-or-empty at open time — and each append is fsynced, which the multi-instance check exercises.
